entries.test: Compare OpenAI’s Senate testimony and subsequent regulatory advocacy and lobbying with Anthropic’s public regulatory advocacy and lobbying.
entries.note: The plain reading contrasts public professions of support with substantive action, which public records can test.

entries.test: Compare contemporaneous public evidence of the companies’ enterprise support, service reliability, and business customers’ reported experiences.
entries.note: OpenAI is the implied comparator. “So far as I can tell” qualifies his knowledge without making the assertion merely a possibility.

entries.test: Compare the companies’ contemporaneous product capabilities, use cases, target customers, and documented competition for customers.
entries.note: The Coke–Pepsi analogy carries a substantive assertion about product similarity and market overlap.

entries.test: Public campaign records, company accounts of advertising strategy, and market evidence could establish whether competition between similar offerings drove both companies’ advertising campaigns.
entries.note: The context implies a causal explanation, but “barely different” strengthens “slightly different.” Advertising here means promoting their products, not placing ads inside both products.
